integrity: Proof, exhaustive labeled C program, independent unlabeled direct-cochain Python program and observed outputs included; self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive classification only for connected simple graphs of order at most seven over F2; witness existence and its groups are already implied by the 2023 suspension theorem. An unindexed equivalent sharp cutoff remains a residual novelty risk.
title: Unique minimal seven-vertex cancellation of bold graph homology
